lines.text: Raghu-anna! Three years and you still walk like you own Majestic.
I do own Majestic. What I don't own any more, apparently, is Jayanagar.
Seenu's boys took the 4th Block shops while you were in Dubai. The shopkeepers pay them now.
Then the shopkeepers can pay me back. With interest.

each.text: Shopkeeper: "Raghu-avaru! We thought you were finished!"
Shopkeeper: "Seenu's men will kill me for this. Take it."
Shopkeeper: "They're here! Seenu's boys, behind you!"

steps.text: Seenu's collectors want their money. Teach them whose it is.

lines.text: (on the phone) Chikka. Jayanagar pays us again.
Seenu won't take it quietly, anna.
I'm counting on it.

missions.title: Rush Hour on the Purple Line

lines.text: (on the phone) Raghu. One of Seenu's accountants has a pen drive. Our accounts. All of them.
He's selling it to ACP Shalini Rao tonight. He's taking the metro from MG Road.
Then he's not getting on that train.

steps.text: Get to MG Road metro station before his train.
steps.failText: His train left. The pen drive is on its way to Shalini Rao.

lines.text: The man with the laptop bag? He saw you and ran out the other exit. Jumped in an auto!
Take it! Take it! I'm only a CA, I have a family!
Then go and be a CA somewhere else. Hosur is nice.
Seenu has a new business. His boys stop every lorry at Silk Board junction and take a 'toll'.
Half of those lorries carry my vegetables. Make it stop.
And take this. My late husband's. He never missed.

ops.text: You got a double-barrel shotgun. Tab to switch weapons.

steps.text: Lose the police. (Good luck getting out of Silk Board.)

lines.text: (on the phone) The lorries are moving again. First time anyone has said that about Silk Board.
(on the phone) Raghavendra. I hear you found a pen drive. I'd like to talk. Cubbon Park bandstand, tonight. Alone.
And if I don't come?
Then I'll come to you. With a hundred constables.

steps.text: Meet ACP Shalini Rao at the Cubbon Park bandstand.
steps.failText: You stood up the ACP. She won't ask nicely again.

lines.text: You came. Good. Raghavendra, you are under arrest.
You said alone.
I am alone. They're not with me. They're with the Crime Branch.

steps.reason: Walked into ACP Shalini Rao's sting

steps.text: It's a trap! Shake off Shalini's task force.

lines.text: Anna! Your face is on every news channel!
Only one person knew I would be at Cubbon Park tonight. Hanu Anna. He sold me to Shalini.
Hanu Anna keeps his files in his SUV. Every deal, every bribe. He never lets it out of his sight.
Then we take the sight and the SUV.
His bodyguards are ex-army. You'll want this.

ops.text: You got an SMG. Hold the trigger to keep firing.

steps.text: Lose the police, and keep the SUV in one piece.
Bring the SUV to Chikka's garage.

lines.text: Anna... these files. Hanu Anna, Seenu, and half the corporation. Even Shalini's boss.
(on the phone) Hanu Anna. I have your files. Call off Shalini, or the newspapers get them.
...What do you want, Raghavendra?
Seenu. Tonight. Tell me where he sleeps.
Hanu Anna sang. Seenu is hiding in the Nayandahalli godowns with every gun he has left.
Twenty years I've known Seenu. He never runs. He'll be waiting.
Good. So will I.

ops.text: Kotte Kumar loaded you up: SMG and shotgun rounds.

steps.text: Go to Seenu's godowns in Nayandahalli.
End it. Take out Seenu and everyone with him.

lines.text: Raghu! Everyone is saying it. Seenu is finished!
Majestic, Chickpete, Jayanagar, Silk Board. All of it is yours, Raghu.
(on the phone) Enjoy it while it lasts, Raghavendra. Files go missing. People don't forget.
Neither do I, madam. Neither do I.

after.title: ACT IV COMPLETE
after.sub: Majestic is Raghu's again. Bengaluru never sleeps, and neither does ACP Shalini Rao.
